system.longDesc:
This is the pistol version of the blunderbuss and the origin of the term dragoon. It shoots a blast 10 yards long and 2 yards wide. Users make one attack roll and compare it to the defense of each target in the blast area. Stunts affect targets individually.

Focus: Black Powder Weapons. Minimum Strength 0. Resources TN 11. Range 10 yards yards. Reload: 1d6 minor actions.
